text.answer:
Davis, CA has the highest median sale price: $889,000, across 941 sales.

Pittsboro, NC is next at $876,986. The lowest median is Urbana, IL at $229,900.

Athens, GA has the mean furthest above its median. Using all rows, its mean sale price is $491,377 and its median is $370,000, a gap of 32.8% of the median.

What causes it: Athens, GA has 4 sales above $5,000,000, the largest recorded at $81,510,000. A mean adds every price together, so one extreme row pulls it up, while the median only looks at the middle sale and barely moves. Without that single largest sale, the mean would be $462,575 and the gap would shrink to 25.0%.
text.chartTitle: Mean and median sale price by city, all rows

text.answer:
3 cities change rank when the price rule is applied:

Athens, GA moves down 2 positions, from 9th to 11th (mean $491,377 with all rows, $455,639 with the price rule)
Madison, WI moves up 1 position, from 10th to 9th (mean $477,144 with all rows, $477,144 with the price rule)
State College, PA moves up 1 position, from 11th to 10th (mean $473,504 with all rows, $474,550 with the price rule)

The other 15 cities keep the same rank.
text.chartTitle: City rank by mean sale price, before and after the price rule

text.answer:
University of Illinois Urbana-Champaign had the largest increase: its median sale price rose +7.6%, from $245,000 in 2024 to $263,500 in 2025.

2 campus areas had a decrease: The University of North Carolina at Chapel Hill (−4.6%, from $745,000 to $710,500) and University of California, Davis (−1.7%, from $900,000 to $885,000).
text.chartTitle: Change in median sale price from 2024 to 2025, by campus area

text.answer:
Slowest: University of Georgia, with a median of 27 days on market.

Fastest: University of Illinois Urbana-Champaign, University of Michigan, University of Virginia and University of Wisconsin-Madison, each with a median of 7 days, a 4-way tie.

Based on the 28,028 sales that have both a list date and a contract date.
text.chartTitle: Days on market by campus area

text.answer:
Highest: University of Illinois Urbana-Champaign, where annual property tax adds up to 1.93% of sale prices ($19,456,633 of tax on $1,008,225,786 of sales).

Lowest: Purdue University, at 0.63% ($8,969,536 on $1,423,523,850).

Based on 34,683 sales with a valid price and a tax amount above $0 and below 10% of the sale price.
text.chartTitle: Annual property tax as a percent of sale price, by campus area

text.answer:
For 3-bedroom homes, Champaign, IL has the lowest median sale price: $215,000, from 1,106 sales.

The highest is Davis, CA at $780,000 (424 sales). 17,028 sales in all match this bedroom count.
text.chartTitle: Median sale price of 3-bedroom homes by city

text.answer:
For 2-bedroom homes, Urbana, IL has the lowest median sale price: $135,500, from 152 sales.

The highest is Davis, CA at $660,000 (46 sales). 3,101 sales in all match this bedroom count.

The longest is Middleton, WI at 44 days (53 sales). 10,913 sales in this range have both dates, and 1 city has none.
